entities.summary: Ivan Ivanovitch Shchukin, Chtchoukine or Stchoukine was a Russian writer and patron of the arts. He was son of Ivan Shchukin (1818-1890) and a younger brother of the collectors Pyotr and Sergei Shchukin.
